1308-7282-8160.easyPrerequisites:
Kwia's ability hasn't triggered this turn.
You have a way to gain life.
1308-7282-8160.description:
Gain life.
Kwia triggers, creating two Lotus tokens due to Anointed Procession.
Activate a Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating two token copies of the Lotus token.
Activate two Loti by tapping and sacrificing them, adding six mana of any color.
Repeat from step 4.
1308-7282-8160.notes: Once you have infinite mana, Chrome Dome can target other artifacts as desired.

728-2033-3249-5553.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2033-3249-5553.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Greedy Freebooter, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

1170-2921-5131-5645--202.easyPrerequisites:
Stenn has "Artifact" chosen.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2921-5131-5645--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Stenn.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

4499-6723-7060-7393.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Activate Niko and the Shards by tapping them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

527-725-1432.notablePrerequisites:
You control another legendary creature.
You control a creature with power 3 or greater.
527-725-1432.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Selvala and another legendary creature.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping the other legendary creature, untapping Ioreth.
Repeat.

333-2281-2921.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Shepherd of the Cosmos
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Saffi triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1115-3490-3755-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1115-3490-3755-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without a stun counter on it

514-654-5256-5944.description:
Activate The Mycosynth Gardens' third ability by paying {1} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Amulet of Vigor.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two stun counters on it.
When Unstoppable Slasher enters, Amulet of Vigor and The Mycosynth Gardens trigger, untapping Unstoppable Slasher twice, which will instead remove both stun counters from Unstoppable Slasher.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1077-2034-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-2292-5220-6539.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Willow Geist.
When Willow Geist dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Willow Geist from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Willow Geist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Willow Geist from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

4567-6734.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 22 minus Greven's power, rounded up to the nearest multiple of 2.
4567-6734.description:
Activate Shadowcloak Vampire by paying 2 life.
Repeat step 1 until Greven has power 21 or greater due to its first ability.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Greven. The opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage from your commander.

914-3036-6633.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3036-6633.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{R}.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
914-3036-6633.notes: If opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

856-4659-5477-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

969-2105-3204-4364.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
969-2105-3204-4364.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1741-1912-4013.notablePrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {C}.
1741-1912-4013.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {C}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5434-5541-5555-5686.notablePrerequisites:
Bazaar Trader does not have summoning sickness.
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
5434-5541-5555-5686.description:
Activate Bazaar Trader by tapping it, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2867-4636-5391-5686.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Robot.
When the Robot dies, Demon of Dark Schemes' second ability triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

413-575-2348.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature.
413-575-2348.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land and as a 2/2 creature due to Nature's Revolt.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1737-2092-2544-3390.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
1737-2092-2544-3390.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Lotus Bloom.
Activate the Lotus Bloom token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

660-1931-2882-4999.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Treva's Attendant.
660-1931-2882-4999.description:
Cast Wild Dogs either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {G}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Treva's Attendant due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Wild Dogs by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {G}{W}{U}.
If you cast Wild Dogs from your graveyard, Wild Dogs is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Wild Dogs's cycling ability.
Repeat.

1651-2557-4259-4659.description:
Activate Collector's Vault by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to loot and create two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Collector's Vault.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Treasure, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

239-2092-2467-4385.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
239-2092-2467-4385.description:
Activate Silver Queen by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Activate the Sliver token by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

803-2060-2567-2893-4482.notablePrerequisites:
Fertilid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
"Plant" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-2060-2567-2893-4482.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Avenger of Zendikar's second ability triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1012-2034-2577.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Repeat.

2634-4821-5049.notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
2634-4821-5049.description:
Activate all mana-producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it to your hand, copying Dramatic Reversal.
Resolve the Dramatic Reversal copy, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Activate all mana-producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

2370-4124-4214.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}, attaching it to Bramble Elemental.
Bramble Elemental triggers, creating two 1/1  Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability twice by sacrificing both Saproling tokens, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2047-2793-4988.notablePrerequisites: Tamiyo's Compleation and Mechanized Production both attached to Ugin's Nexus.
2047-2793-4988.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
The token copy of Ugin's Nexus is put into exile as a state based action due to the legend rule, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

913-938-1582-2034-3771.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
913-938-1582-2034-3771.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Marang River Prowler, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Cast Marang River Prowler from your graveyard for {U}.
Ominous Roost triggers, creating a 1/1 Bird creature token.
Repeat.

3230-3932-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Hope Tender does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Hope Tender.
You control an additional land that can tap for mana.
3230-3932-4222.description:
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding {C}{U} .
Activate your additional land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Hope Tender's last ability by paying {1}, tapping it, and exerting it, untapping Coral Atoll and a land that can tap for mana.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Hope Tender.
Repeat any number of times.
